items.lead: Backend engineering for distributed systems on AWS, designing and maintaining seven Python and FastAPI microservices within an event-driven architecture.
bullets: Co-designed and implemented a telemetry platform for up to 300,000 vehicles, using Kinesis, Lambda, and SQS for ingestion and processing, with DynamoDB and PostgreSQL for persistence.
Optimized asynchronous processing, vehicle state management in DynamoDB, and PostgreSQL connection pooling. Assessed scalability with JMeter load tests.
Designed and implemented multi-tenant architectures with data isolation, authentication, and access control. Documented architecture decisions in ADRs.

items.lead: Full-stack internship on Telefónica’s digital products, focused on web accessibility, performance, and internal engineering tools.
bullets: Designed and built an internal platform with React, Express, and MongoDB to automate accessibility audit management and reporting.
Built web applications with Next.js and React, using the Mística Design System to deliver consistent, accessible interfaces.
Improved accessibility in line with WCAG guidelines, optimized web performance, and applied SEO best practices across digital products.

about.heading: About
narrative: I’m a Software Engineer focused on backend and distributed systems, building scalable cloud services with Python, FastAPI and AWS.
At Génexys I build microservices and event-driven architectures, work on offline geospatial navigation for low-connectivity environments, and create agentic engineering workflows with Claude Code.
I enjoy designing systems that are simple, reliable and built to scale.
